$comment: Verified false positives for scripts/check-meta-commentary.mjs (cinatra-ai/docs#114). Each entry suppresses one pattern id on one exact source LINE (the "snippet" field is the full trimmed line, not just the matched phrase) — two different sentences in the same file can share a short phrase like "generated from", so a second, unrelated line needs its own entry. The file still describes a real Cinatra product behavior that happens to match a docs-meta phrase; it is not commentary about how this documentation site is produced. Every entry needs owner + reviewBy so it does not silently become permanent: once reviewBy passes the entry stops suppressing (the gate reds again) until a human re-verifies and renews the date, or removes the entry.

entries.snippet: The taskSpec stored in the DB is compiled from this file. When a chat assistant creates a new agent via `agent_save`, it should also write the SKILL.md via `agent_source_write`.
entries.note: Describes the agent build pipeline (SKILL.md -> taskSpec), not docs generation.

entries.snippet: In short: removing a published version does not uninstall it from instances that already installed it, and uninstalling/archiving on an instance does not retract a marketplace release. Use the lifecycle operations to manage installed state and the registry operations to manage published versions — do not hand-edit manifest rows or delete package-store files.
entries.note: Operator instruction about DB/package-store rows, not about editing a docs page.

entries.snippet: - **Skills** — reusable prompts and workflows shared team-wide, auto-generated from each connected app's registered capabilities, and usable as slash commands by any connected agent.
